title: 2026 Brookfield Corporation Investor Day: The Future Is Compounding
description: Hear from Brookfield Corporation President Nick Goodman at 2026 Investor Day.
summary: The interview argues that Brookfield Corporation is well-positioned to double its core earnings over the next five years, driven by scaling fee-bearing capital and growing insurance assets. This growth is supported by a realistic plan to earn and reinvest up to $6 billion of capital from direct investments. Additionally, the company leverages its pricing power in real estate due to a chronic shortage of high-quality supply and excess demand.

claims.quote: And we think about that in the next 5 years, it leaves us well positioned to double our core earnings again over the next five years, taking our DE before realizations to just north of 11.5 billion

claims.claim: The business is well positioned to continue scaling earnings with a planned 24% compound annual growth rate over the next five years.
claims.quote: And that leaves us well positioned to continue to scale the earnings of the business planning for that 24% compound annual growth rate as I said over the next 5 years

claims.claim: Brookfield Asset Management plans to scale fee-bearing capital to $1.3 trillion with an 18% annual growth rate in distributable earnings.

claims.claim: The company expects to earn and resurface up to $6 billion of capital from direct investments available for reinvestment over the planned period.

claims.claim: The company has pricing power in its real estate business due to a chronic shortage of high-quality supply and excess demand.
claims.quote: In real estate, what we're now seeing is those improving fundamentals that I talked about means that different to five years ago, today we have pricing power in our real estate business
